evidence: app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss:522 (.group-member-info .name) changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The same change happens at app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss:497. dark-light-choose's first argument is the light-theme result (common/foundation/variables.scss:46-51), so light themes regress from 30% to 50%. Every other conversion in the diff keeps the original value as the light arg and uses (100-x)% on $secondary, so the fix should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)).

app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:182 (h3) changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%) to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:291 (h4 a) changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)). The two values look swapped, so light themes go from 30% to 70% and the link gets much lighter. The reviewer's 'inconsistent with dark value' wording is slightly muddled, but the regression and the suggested fix (30% / 70%) are correct and follow the pattern used everywhere else in the PR.

app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss:102 (.custom-message-length) changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)).
